newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol buys 45 pct stake in Spanish firm.
newsitem.headline: Endemol buys 45 pct stake in Spanish firm.

text.p: Dutch television production company Endemol Entertainment NV said on Thursday it had acquired a 45 percent stake in Spanish production company Zeppelin.
It said Zeppelin had a turnover of slightly above 30 million guilders in 1996/97 and would contribute to Endemol's earnings per share in this financial year.
Endemol also has the option to acquire a "substantial majority" of Zeppelin shares in the future.
The Spanish company's most important commisioning clients were Tele 5, TVE and regional stations such as Telemadrid, Canal Sur and Canal 9, Endemol added.
